Anya: midday release pulse — drop 1) what you finished yesterday 2) blockers 3) plan for today
Mike: ✅ landed the backport for model-quant fix into release/v1.8 yesterday. Blocker: ci-gpu-2 keeps failing an integration test (looks timing-related). Today: re-run with debug flags and open a PR to skip flaky test if it keeps failing.
Celine: finished the release notes draft for v1.8. No blockers. Today: will push tweaks and ask docs for a screenshot of the new console metrics.
Kevin: looked at the canary metrics this morning. After the 10:10 deploy we saw a small p50 bump in the encoder path. Blocker: header propagation drop on a particular route (region-eu-west). I have a trace and a proposed header-fix patch; will try rolling to 10% with the header patch later today. @Anya @Mike
Jamal: cherry-pick ready for the hotfix (PR 4989). Command I used:
```
# cherry-pick into release/v1.8
git checkout release/v1.8
git pull origin release/v1.8
git cherry-pick -x 7a3f2b1
git push origin release/v1.8
```
Blocker: need approval from infra-owners for the backport change to low-level allocator (pinged @Kevin). Today: will queue the canary once infra sign-off is in.
Mike: opened PR for the test-skip fallback: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4990 — includes extra logging.
deploy-bot: Canary status at 1769997800 — canary(5%) healthy, 95th percentile latency 118ms, error-rate 0.4%. Rolling to 20% now.
Kevin: posting the trace here: https://observability.redwood.ai/trace/abcd1234 — looks like a missing x-region header in a small subset of requests. Patch attached in my branch kevin/header-prop-fix.
Celine: added the changelog note for the skip-test as a temp measure. I'll edit later if the infra rollback happens.
Anya: plan checklist — Mike follow up on CI logs + PR 4990, Kevin try 10% header-patch canary and update trace, Jamal wait on infra sign-off then trigger backport rollout, Celine finalize notes for release page. If anything blocks rollout ping here asap.
Mike: will also attach the failing test logs in the PR shortly.
Jamal: infra approval came in (thread in ops). I queued the backport canary to 5% pre-noon; watching.
deploy-bot: Backport canary deployed at 1769997888 — health checks passing, monitoring.
Kevin: canary with header fix at 10% looks good after 12 mins. No extra errors.
Anya: lovely — if both canaries stay green we'll prep the cut window checklist. I'll follow-up with a short rollback playbook just in case. :thumbsup:
Mike: noted, will be online for the cut.
Celine: I'll send the final release note link when merged.
Jamal: standing by for the full push; will coordinate with @Kevin for rollout timing.
Anya: thanks team. If anyone sees regressions drop a quick note here and tag on-call.
